svg.title: TYPE_REBALANCE_GARAGE -> PlanRebalanceGarageJob()
svg.desc: Keep the right share of bays in insert mode. The method asks ComputeBayRebalancingActions() which bays to switch, then runs the READY_FOR_INSERT and READY_FOR_RETRIEVE recipes with the same job_index.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. Ask which bays should switch to insert mode and which to retrieve mode, given the readiness ratio ('Bays, VECS and VRCs'). In this example: Illustrative result: B7 should become insert-ready, B21 retrieve-ready. 'Bays, VECS and VRCs' explains the classification and the ratio. ([B7], [B21])", "Row 3. Run the READY_FOR_INSERT recipe for each bay that should accept cars, under this job's index. In this example: Empty tray T5 (nearest, illustrative) into B7, then B7 to insert mode. (adds 1, 2)", "Row 4. Run the READY_FOR_RETRIEVE recipe for each bay that should hand cars out, under this job's index. In this example: B21 to retrieve mode, then T21 out. Rule B links 3 to 2 because both recipes share job_index 0. (adds 3, 4 \u00b7 B)", "Row 5. Report success; failures of individual bays are only logged. In this example: (success)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): AGV-1 drives empty W11 -> W9 -> P5 and stops under T5 (the approach for event 1; AGV assignment adds such moves later).", "Playing the plan: event 1. AGV-1 lifts T5, carries it P5 -> W9 -> W8 -> W31 -> B7 and lowers it.", "Playing the plan: event 2. B7 switches to READY_TO_INSERT.", "Playing the plan: event 3. B21 switches to READY_TO_RETRIEVE.", "Playing the plan: AGV-1 drives empty B7 -> W31 -> W8 -> W13 -> W18 -> W22 -> W41 -> B21 and stops under T21 (the approach for event 4; AGV assignment adds such moves later).", "Playing the plan: event 4. AGV-1 lifts T21, carries it B21 -> W41 -> W22 -> P23 and lowers it. The destination P23 is illustrative: tray assignment fills the '?' later. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
